jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, AI Private Banker
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

Once here, you will:

  • Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

  • Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

  • Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

  • Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

  • Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

  • Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

  • Experience in digital products;

  • Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

  • Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 20 days time off and 14 company holidays. 

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid (3 days in-office per week): Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Crypto, SV) - US - IC7 - 2026
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nu is building crypto products that give customers real financial access — moving assets, interacting with blockchain networks, and managing digital assets safely and simply. As a Staff Software Engineer on our crypto product team, you will combine deep understanding of blockchain protocols with strong product instincts to decide what we build, how it works technically, and how it should feel for the customer.

You'll work hands-on with onchain data, transaction flows, signing and custody integrations, asset movement, and smart-contract interactions — not to build these as isolated platform pieces, but to turn them into product capabilities customers actually use. You'll partner closely with product and business stakeholders to shape what Nu builds, and with the core crypto team to integrate with the protocol- and security-level building blocks they provide.

You'll be responsible for

  • Understand blockchain protocols deeply enough to know how to integrate with them and what they make possible for customers — then turn that into product decisions.

  • Build and evolve product-facing capabilities involving onchain data, transaction execution, signing and custody integrations, asset movement between wallets and entities, and smart-contract interactions.

  • Partner with product and business stakeholders to define what crypto experiences Nu should offer, weighing technical feasibility, customer value, and business tradeoffs.

  • Integrate with core crypto team systems (custody, key management, security primitives), owning the product and integration layer while collaborating closely on lower-level implementation details when needed.

  • Design APIs and abstractions that let your team and others ship crypto features quickly without reproducing protocol complexity or weakening controls.

  • Establish standards for reliability, observability, data integrity, and production readiness.

  • Lead critical design reviews, major-incident response, and root-cause analysis for the systems you own.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the bar for technical and product judgment on the team.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • A track record of Staff-level impact building customer-facing products or platforms, ideally with meaningful technical depth in a specific domain.

  • Deep experience with distributed systems at scale, including transaction processing, eventual consistency, failure handling, high availability, and production operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical understanding of protocols or infrastructure into product decisions and customer-facing features.

  • Production ownership of regulated or high-stakes financial movement, blockchain integrations, or adjacent money-moving infrastructure.

  • Experience designing security-sensitive systems using threat modeling, explicit trust boundaries, defensive architecture, and rigorous review processes.

  • Comfort partnering with product and business stakeholders as a peer in shaping what gets built, not just how.

  • Experience leading complex production incidents and improving systems and operating practices afterward.

  • Strong influence, communication, and mentorship skills, including the ability to align teams without relying on reporting authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating with multiple blockchain networks or protocol families.

  • Experience shaping product or business strategy for crypto or digital-asset offerings.

  • Familiarity with HSMs, secure enclaves, or hardware-backed key-management systems.

  • Experience in regulated fintech, banking, payments, or institutional digital-asset infrastructure.

  • Experience reviewing smart-contract security or integrating with DeFi protocols in production.

Location: Palo Alto, United States

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (Crypto, SV) - IC8+ - US - 2026
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nu is building crypto products that give millions of customers real, secure financial access — moving assets, interacting with blockchain networks, and managing digital assets safely and simply. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the senior-most technical leader connecting deep crypto and blockchain expertise to what Nu builds for customers, setting the multi-year direction for how we turn protocol-level capabilities into products at scale.

This role requires genuine, hands-on depth in blockchain protocols, custody, signing, and on-chain systems. At the same time, you're expected to reason beyond protocol design: partnering with product and business leaders to decide what Nu builds, how it creates value for customers, and how it fits Nu's broader strategy.

You'll operate across the full stack of crypto product development — from the technical judgment needed to evaluate protocol tradeoffs and security posture, to the product and business judgment needed to prioritize what gets built next. You'll partner closely with the core crypto team on deep technical and security work while driving the product and architectural direction that shapes what customers actually experience.

You'll be responsible for

  • Set multi-year technical and product direction for Nu's crypto systems, grounded in deep expertise in blockchain protocols, on-chain data, custody, signing, and smart-contract integrations.

  • Partner with product and business leaders to define what crypto experiences Nu should build next, weighing technical feasibility, security posture, customer value, and business strategy together.

  • Lead the architecture of highly consequential, security-critical crypto capabilities while remaining hands-on in key technical and protocol-level decisions.

  • Translate deep technical understanding of blockchain systems into concrete product capabilities and customer-facing features, not just infrastructure.

  • Anticipate scalability, reliability, security, and regulatory challenges specific to crypto/blockchain systems, and set standards that raise the bar across teams building on top of your work.

  • Drive complex initiatives across team and organizational boundaries, building alignment among engineering, product, business, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership through major security incidents or production events involving crypto infrastructure, translating lessons into lasting improvements.

  • Mentor Staff+ engineers and engineering leaders, and serve as one of Nu's technical reference points on crypto and blockchain systems.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise in blockchain and crypto systems — protocols, on-chain data, custody, signing/key management, wallets, asset movement, or smart contracts.

  • A sustained record of Staff+ level technical leadership with impact spanning multiple teams or domains.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate deep protocol/technical understanding into customer-facing product decisions and business outcomes, not just architecture.

  • Experience leading highly complex, ambiguous, security-critical initiatives requiring both technical depth and cross-functional judgment.

  • Ability to reason about business models, product strategy, and market positioning alongside technical tradeoffs.

  • Ability to influence engineering leaders, product leaders, security, risk, and compliance stakeholders without formal authority.

  • A strong record of mentoring senior/staff engineers and raising the quality of technical and product decision-making around them.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and business audiences in high-stakes environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience shaping product or business strategy for crypto or digital-asset offerings specifically, beyond technical architecture.

  • Experience across multiple blockchain networks or protocol families.

  • Experience with HSMs, secure enclaves, or hardware-backed key-management infrastructure.

  • Experience in regulated banking, fintech, payments, or institutional digital assets.

  • Recognition as a technical reference in crypto, blockchain security, or distributed systems.

Location: Palo Alto, United States

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here
